description: Figure 7 illustrates the relationship between the number of training samples and the Micro F1 percentage of KnowPrompt. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Generated Samples” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 64, with tick labels at intervals of 8. The y-axis is labeled “Micro F1 (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 55, with tick labels at intervals of 5. There are three lines displayed: a solid blue line representing “w/o DPO obs & w/o div-hint”, a solid orange line representing “DPO”, and a solid green line representing “Average of w/o DPO obs & w/o div-hint”. The blue line starts at approximately 1.8% at x=0 and increases to approximately 48.8% at x=64. The orange line begins at approximately 2.8% at x=0 and rises to approximately 51.2% at x=64. The green line starts at approximately 2.3% at x=0 and increases to approximately 49.9% at x=64.
